status: frozen hypotheses and analysis before outcome inspection; implementation must pass blinded tests before unblinding
cohort: 10.17632/hr94h42xdc.3, Data S4 raw wells; Data S1 supplies PDO sample-to-patient identifiers only
development_source: Farin 10.17632/fypp6xhkjy.1; Kryeziu design and identifier metadata reviewed, signal/viability and mutation values not exposed or analyzed
hypothesis: With the fixed development GP, exact equal-cost batch selection reduces held-out plate log-response error relative to random selection under the same estimator and purchased-well budget.
primary_population: Single-agent contexts admitted by paired_inventory and with a unique explicit PDO patient mapping from Data S1. No patient-ID inference from sample-name patterns.
orientation: p1 selectable pool, p2 independent technical-plate audit. Reverse p2/p1 is a prespecified sensitivity analysis, not an alternative primary result.
validity: After unblinding, exclude an entire context if any of its candidate treatment/control or audit treatment/control signals is missing, nonfinite or nonpositive. Record every exclusion by original row and reason. Do not exclude by response magnitude, activity, model residual or published DSS.
endpoint: At each common drug dose: natural log audit raw treatment RLU minus the mean natural log RLU of all negative-control wells on its audit plate. This is a raw-signal contrast, not the authors' background-corrected normalized viability, DSS or a clinical endpoint.
pool: All single-agent treatment wells for the context plus all DMSO control_negative wells from its pool plate. Positive controls and combinations are excluded. DMSO identifies vehicle controls even where the source concentration annotation is missing or zero; source annotations remain preserved.
initial_measurements: One pool control (lowest original source-row number), lowest dose and highest dose. Three unit-cost assays, common to every method.
cost: One assay unit per purchased well, including controls. Shared controls are charged in full per isolated context; no multi-drug amortization or currency savings claim. Audit measurements and historical development costs are reported separately.
coordinate: log1p(d/min_positive_dose), divided by the maximum over the context. Pinned Matern 5/2 kernel; no target-cohort tuning.
candidate_design: Exact fixed-cardinality variance minimization after the three seed assays. Distinct budget campaigns need not be nested. Exchangeable control subsets may be collapsed only after validating joint-law symmetry; compare against exhaustive enumeration in bounded tests.
primary_reference: Same fixed joint GP, random remaining-well permutation with NumPy default_rng seeds 0 through 19. Average seeds before curve and patient aggregation.
additional_comparisons: diagonal-noise GP with matched marginal observation variance and fixed development parameters
primary_metric: Mean MSE across all integer budgets from 3 through the full context pool size, with equal budget weight within context. Average contexts within sample, samples within patient, then patients equally.
inference: 10000 paired patient-cluster bootstrap resamples, default_rng seed 1729. Keep every method and dose/budget outcome from a sampled patient together. Report paired absolute difference and relative mean-MSE reduction with percentile 95% intervals.
primary_success: At least 5% relative mean-MSE reduction and the paired absolute-difference 95% interval entirely below zero. Otherwise report failed or inconclusive confirmation; no post-test tuning or replacement primary endpoint.
efficiency_secondary: For each context set random-reference budget to ceil(0.75 * full_pool_size), and exact-design budget to floor(0.8 * reference_budget). Require both budgets >=3. Compare held-out MSE with identical patient aggregation; a 20% assay-reduction statement requires the upper paired-bootstrap 95% bound of candidate/reference aggregate MSE ratio <=1.05. This is fixed-budget noninferiority, not learned sequential stopping.
uncertainty_secondary: Report marginal nominal-90% predictive coverage and width over audit doses. Predictive variance adds noise_sd squared times (1 + 1/audit_control_count). Audit-dose errors share their control mean; no simultaneous, per-patient or distribution-free coverage guarantee.
sensitivity: reverse plate orientation without changing the primary conclusion
patient-wise effects and full budget curves
release_rule: Preserve the first evaluation and all failures. Any later revised model is development on this cohort and requires another untouched cohort for a new confirmation claim. No ranking guarantee follows from confirmation.
